pais.texto:
South Africa has twelve official languages. English is the first language of under 10% of the population, but it is the language of the news, the law and business.
South African English took words like braai and lekker from Afrikaans. And there, a traffic light is called a “robot”!
fatos: 12, including English, Zulu, Xhosa and Afrikaans

lesson.introText: Today, we’ll talk about South Africa. We’ll take a look at its languages, food, wildlife and history.
lesson.introSub: Twelve languages, braai, wildlife and history

fotos.texto: A braai is much more than a barbecue: it is the gathering itself. South Africans invite friends with: “Come for a braai!”
Half a loaf of bread, hollowed out and filled with curry. It was invented by the Indian community of Durban.
One of the largest wildlife parks in Africa, with lions, elephants and rhinos.
The prison island where Nelson Mandela spent 18 years. Today it is a museum and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
A stretch of coast in the south of the country, with forest, beaches and lagoons.
The singer who took songs in Xhosa to stages around the world.
